en: Stylized illustrated view of a stone path bordered by low stone walls and lush green trees, leading toward a village of white-roofed houses nestled among greenery beside a river. In the forested hillside on the opposite bank a small castle or ruin is visible. At the bottom of the image appear the artist's signature and the captions indicating the Wachau region and the town of Weissenkirchen.
